nodes.name: Event Intake Webhook
nodes.notes: All agents and external systems POST events here. Payload must include: source, event_type, severity, timestamp, raw_data

parameters.text:
⚠️ *Low Confidence Event — Human Review Required*

*Event ID:* `{{ $json._constellation_event_id }}`
*Type:* `{{ $json.event_type }}`
*Source:* `{{ $json.source }}`
*Confidence:* `{{ $json.confidence_score }}%` (below 40% threshold)
*Severity:* `{{ $json.severity }}`

This event did not meet the minimum confidence threshold for automated routing. Manual triage required.

🚨 *Routing Error — Unknown Event Type*

*Received:* `{{ $json.event_type }}`
*Source:* `{{ $json.source }}`
*Time:* `{{ $json._received_at }}`

No agent registered for this event type. Add it to the route map in `master-orchestrator.json`.

meta.description: Central routing hub. Normalizes all incoming events, computes base confidence, and routes to the correct agent webhook. Logs every event to PostgreSQL.
